programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Ohio, police discover a young woman lying near railroad tracks - a railroad spike plunged in her head. She dies a few hours later. Police arrest a man seen with her that night - but another man brags about the killing. Which man is responsible? Psychic Karyol Kirkpatrick helps investigators uncover the truth. In northern California, a young woman never makes it home after visiting loved ones. Authorities find her broken down car and determine she was last seen with a deadly fugitive. Without any clues to her whereabouts, investigators turn to psychic Kathlyn Rhea for guidance.

programme.title: Is It Haunted?

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: Richard investigates claims that the supposed mastermind behind the 9/11 terrorist attacks and leader of the Al Qaeda terrorist cell remained a CIA asset until his death. Further, an investigative journalist, the editor of an intelligence magazine and an historian argue that bin Laden was not responsible for the planning of the attacks and that the evidence suggests Bin Laden died in December 2001, and not at the hands of US Navy Seals in May 2011.
